short.q: Explain why 'I like this one' is weak annotation.
short.model: It gives no reason, no art vocabulary and no decision, so it shows no thinking about intentions or choices.

short.q: Rewrite: 'I tried watercolour and it didn't work.'
short.model: I tried watercolour on thin paper but the colours ran and lost sharp edges, so I will try gouache for crisp shapes.

short.q: Describe Starry Night using content, form, process and mood.
short.model: A village under a swirling night sky (content); curved lines and blue/yellow contrast (form); thick oil impasto (process); restless, emotional mood.

short.q: Why should annotation be short and specific?
short.model: Examiners need clear evidence of your thinking quickly; long unrelated writing is not purposeful and may not be read.
Ask what you intended, what happened, why, and what you will do next.
